name: XNA 4.0 GamerServices, Avatar and Net
description: The Windows XNA 4.0 GamerServices, Avatar and Net assemblies. Backed by CNA's native GamerServices/Guide/Avatar/Net implementation; kept as a profile of its own so the 256-type runtime profile's result is not mixed with it. Game.dll is listed only for GamerServicesComponent, which XNA declares there; the namespace filter keeps nothing else from it.
